summary.text: Juan Estrada is the Democratic candidate for Georgia House of Representatives District 109 in the November 3, 2026 general election; the seat has no incumbent.
An attorney who opened his own law practice after graduating from Georgia State University College of Law in 2019, he lists Gwinnett County as his home of 20 years.

paragraphs.text: Estrada earned a high school diploma from Norcross High School, a bachelor's degree from Georgia Gwinnett College in 2014 and a law degree from the Georgia State University College of Law in 2019, according to Ballotpedia.
In a Ballotpedia survey, he described himself as the son of immigrants and said he worked full time through law school as an insurance adjuster or paralegal.

He said he interned at the Senate Budget Committee under U.S. Senator Bernard Sanders, then opened Juan Estrada Law, representing injured parties, tenants and people seeking claims against insurance companies.
Estrada said he spent about two years at the Fulton County Housing Court Assistance Center helping people at risk of losing their homes during the Covid pandemic.
He advanced from the Democratic primary on May 19, 2026, and his key campaign messages centered on the cost of living, including housing, electric bills and insurance.
